name: Koumura Toshio
source: Toshio Koumura is a language teacher at Hikarizaka high school and Tomoya's home room teacher during his first year. His age conceals his once vigorous past marked by his enthusiasm in teaching. He was friends with Kouko Ibuki three years ago.
translation: 春原俊夫是光坂高中语言教师，也是朋也一年级时的班主任。他的年龄掩盖了曾经充满活力、热衷教学的过去。三年前，他与伊吹风子是朋友。
